summary: BSTR Newco, LLC entered a $2.5M loan agreement with BSTR Holdings (Cayman) for operating costs and expenses related to a pending business combination with Cantor Equity Partners I, Inc. Interest is SOFR plus 3.90%, payable annually; principal due at earliest of business combination consummation, dissolution, or two years. No price/share, premium, or board recommendation stated. This is a financing arrangement supporting a previously announced deal, not a standalone special situation. Watch for progress on the business combination and any default triggers.
